statement: The complete complex divisor norm limit is the explicitly specified restricted sum of unique fixed prime chains; vanishing of all displayed prime-class sums is necessary and sufficient for a coherent completed multiplicative lift, each nonempty fiber is the evaluated ordinary-unit norm product, and the full positional rational divisor map has exactly the rank-three kernel supported at3 and17.
where_proved: sections/E_norm_divisors.tex, formulas(E72.1)-(E72.16) and the complete proof; code/e_norm_divisors.gp and code/e_norm_divisors.py with retained outputs

notes: The exact class equations retain the actual higher class matrices as unevaluated data; no completed numerical classification of those matrices is claimed.
The exponent h is still unevaluated. It is proved to be the eventual exponent of the specified prime-above3 ideal classes.
The multiplication completions and divisor groups are prodiscrete and generally noncompact. Only fixed principal-divisor fibers are used as compact spaces.
The base root-of-unity phase is computed by the literal first norm of E.57, independently of the ordinary-unit choice.
Every H toric fiber with second coordinate supported on{3,17} consists of genuine{3,17}-unit norm systems at all levels; no lift through intrinsic metabelian/marked kernels is inferred.
